stem: Which of these was an effect of the Industrial Revolution on U.S. women in the early nineteenth century?

options.label: A
options.text: Women in unions gained bargaining power with employers.

options.label: B
options.text: The government passed laws to improve safety for women in the workplace.

options.label: C
options.text: Women seeking work migrated from rural communities to cities.

options.label: D
options.text: State governments called conventions in support of women’s suffrage.
